title: I will let you know more when I manage to get it installed
text: I will let you know more when I manage to get it installed. The clips are a pain in the butt to get into the wall. This comes with a lot of pieces. It could be easier. Doesn't help that it is really hot in the room where I want to install it and I gave up.

product_metadata.title: ClosetMaid 5632 Super Slide Ventilated Shelf Kit With Closet Rod, 6' by 12", White
features: Super Slide shelving allows hangers to continuously slide without interruption
For sturdiness: NEVER install wall clips more than 12-inches apart, Drill 1/4-inch holes at marked locations (DO NOT PUNCH HOLES)
Per manufacturer's specifications: weight capacity for shelf: 60-pounds (evenly distributed), Hang rod weight capacity: 15-pounds per linear foot (evenly distributed)
Easy to install and perfect for any room, Kit includes: wire shelf, hang bar, hang bar support(s) and installation hardware
Constructed of vinyl coated steel, Shelving is SCS Certified for minimum of 91% recycled content
description: ClosetMaid's top of the line shelving system for closets offers continuous sliding action. Hang rods attach to the SuperSlide shelving for continuous slide for hangers. SuperSlide shelving is perfect for folded clothes, linens, and other closet items. With the addition of a SuperSlide closet rod support and closet rod, it forms a hanging system that allows hangers to slide freely end to end.

details.Warranty Description: Manufacturer will replace any missing or damaged part due to manufacturer defect for 30 days after purchase. Please have proof of purchase for warranty claims. Combining closetmaid branded products with third party components or products will void the closetmaid manufacturer’s warranty.
